validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --service-package tests/ui/service-events/reply.service.json?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="waiting">
  <state id="waiting">
    <invoke type="urn:example:reply" id="reply"/>
    <transition event="reply.ready" target="done" event:schema='{"type":"string"}'/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: this `event:schema` is not the schema the service package declares for `reply.ready`

primary.message: differs from the service's declared event schema

notes: the service package of `urn:example:reply` declares that it emits `reply.ready` with the schema sha256:e3dce8d1afb8 (`{"properties":{"text":{"type":"string"}},"required":["text"],"type":"object"}`); a transition that handles the event while the service runs describes the same data, so its schema must be that one (canonical JSON, compared exactly) or `true`
diagnostics.help: use the package's schema for the event, or correct the service package if the document is right

fixes.message: use the schema the package declares for `reply.ready`
